actual.descripcion: The Squirrels see a rainbow for the very first time, but it disappears so quickly. Together they decide to create a rainbow themselves from everything around them.

siguiente.descripcion: The naughty Terrible Twos are making brainwashing custard pies and Eight is tangled up. Can 1, 2, 3, two 4's, 5, 6, 7 and 8 save the day and stop 4 Terrible Twos making Octonaughty and defeat him and put him in the pie?

lista.descripcion: The Squirrels see a rainbow for the very first time, but it disappears so quickly. Together they decide to create a rainbow themselves from everything around them.

The naughty Terrible Twos are making brainwashing custard pies and Eight is tangled up. Can 1, 2, 3, two 4's, 5, 6, 7 and 8 save the day and stop 4 Terrible Twos making Octonaughty and defeat him and put him in the pie?
The number friends all want to do different things today, so rocket Ten finds a clever way to do them all. Learn all the ways to add to ten with the Numberblocks.
Squarey, we're not in Numberland any more! Four visits Flatland, where the flat shapes live, and becomes a real square. Learn about 2D shapes with the Numberblocks.
One and her chums carefully cross the pattern puzzle paths over the magic moats to get to the Pattern Palace. Learn about patterns with the Numberblocks.

lista.titulo: Numberblocks - The Legend of Big Tum
lista.descripcion: A big hairy monster with a big hairy tummy who loves puzzles? Find out who is in Big Tum's tum! Learn how to find missing numbers with the Numberblocks.
One makes a wish that the magic mirror could make lots of friends at once, and pretty soon it's pandemonium. Learn about repeat addition with the Numberblocks.

lista.titulo: Peg + Gato - The Silliest Song Problem
lista.descripcion: Peg and Cat must present the King with the silliest song in the land.
Cleaning up becomes a fun group activity.
A runaway balloon leads to a chase.
Can the friends stay silent for a whole day?
Roberto becomes overly protective, causing issues.
Pocoyo builds a car, but driving isn't as easy as it seems.
A Bluey y a Bingo les toca bañarse, pero papá ha decidido no decirles qué hacer y acaba jugando al juego de la hamburguesería.
Sigue las aventuras de un cachorro de Blue Heeler que vive con su papá, su madre y su hermanita.
Mamá, papá y Bingo tienen que superar las clases de natación, pero agradar a Margaret, la estricta profesora (que es Bluey), les res resulta muy difícil.

En el parque, Bluey conoce a una nueva compañera de juegos, Winnie. Pero cuando Bluey quiere invitar a ella y a su padre a desayunar en casa, se da cuenta de que los adultos tardan más en hacerse amigos.
Cuando mamá y papá tienen una discusión, Bluey pone a papá a escribirle una carta de amor a mamá para hacer las paces. Ahora, Bluey debe encontrar la forma de hacerle llegar la carta a mamá.
Sigue las aventuras de un cachorro de Blue Heeler que vive con su papá, su madre y su hermanita.

lista.titulo: Puffin Rock - El caparazón brillante /La amigable Flynne / Cama de plumas
lista.descripcion: Oona y Baba llaman la atención sin querer con un caparazón, hacen amigos y buscan por doquier ropa de cama.

lista.titulo: Pregunte a los StoryBots - How Do Eyes See?
lista.descripcion: The StoryBots brave a castle on a dark and stormy night to understand how eyesight works. Maria Bamford guest-stars as an eccentric scientist.

lista.titulo: Los Octonautas en tierra firme - The Octonauts and the Beetle Invasion
lista.descripcion: Kwazii and grandad Calico Jack find a new island home for a band of beetles.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Something Broken, Someone Blue
lista.descripcion: Thomas has been playing hard with Boxy, certain that his beloved friend/co-worker/toy will last forever. But when Thomas' careless behaviour leads to Boxy's being broken beyond repair, Thomas must confront his own behaviour.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - The Sights of Sodor
lista.descripcion: It's a beautiful summer day on Sodor and Sir Topham Hatt has a surprise: a special plaque with a map of the island atop Lookout Mountain! Sir Topham Hatt recruits the engines to lead "The Sight of Sodor" tour: to the plaque and back, missing all of the real tourist attractions! The engines are not enthusiastic about Sir Topham Hatt's attraction -- and neither are the island's visitors! As less and less passengers board Annie and Clarabel to see the plaque, Thomas and the gang decide to take matters into their own wheels and show off their favorite places on Sodor -- resulting in a lot more fun in the sun!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - What's the Buzz
lista.descripcion: A swarm of bees takes shelter in Thomas' funnel, and he has to find a more suitable home for his new friends.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Bells are Ringing
lista.descripcion: When Percy's lucky bell goes missing after his deliveries, he enlists Thomas to embark on a quest to crack the Case of the Missing Bell and solve who has stolen his prized possession.
Simón y su hermano pequeño Gaspar se montan por primera vez en avión.
Simón hace una carrera de trineos con sus amigos.
Gaspar no quiere separarse de su hermano mayor en ningún momento.
During a rainstorm, some tires go missing from Wheeler's store. Is there a thief in town, or does the mystery have another explanation?
Helly is disappointed when nobody remembers his birthday. Later, Poli and the gang search for a way to make it up to their friend.

lista.titulo: Robocar Poli - Where Are You Going, Cleany?
lista.descripcion: When an out-of-order charging station sends Cleany into overdrive, it's up to the Rescue Team to calm him down before someone gets hurt.

Bluey tiene por delante un día que tiene muchas y diferentes actividades. Algunas son tareas cotidianas que debe hacer en su casa, como ordenar sus cosas y limpiar su lugar. Pero las que más le gustan a él son las que están relacionadas con los juegos y la diversión, por supuesto.
Cuando Muffin no puede parar de chuparse el dedo, tiene que ponerse el cono de la vergüenza. Pero el cono la entorpece y ya no puede jugar a la "bocatería" con Bluey y Bingo.
